definitions.short: (only in plural collective) weariness , i.e. (by implication) toil ( treasure so obtained) or speed
definitions.full: H8443. toaphah [ תּוֺעָפָה ] noun feminine eminence ; of towering horns (? see Di) לוֺ רְאֵם כְּתוֺעֲפֹת Num 23:22 ; 24:8 , simile of strength of Israel; of peaks לוֺ הָרִים תּוֺעֲפוֺת Psa 95:4 (|| מֶחְקְרֵיאָֿ֑רֶץ ); of silver Job 22:25 לָ֑ךְ תּוֺעָפוֺת כֶּסֶף , very dubious, perhaps heaps or bars (ingots).
